jobs.title: Senior Manager, Growth Strategy & Insights
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Hi, I’m George Shang - I lead Jane’s Growth Strategy & Operations team. I’m looking for an experienced, analytical & strategic thinker to help us address some of Jane’s most pressing growth opportunities.

The Senior Manager, Growth Strategy & Insights will work in our growth group to tackle key problems over a wide range of topics, such as growth analysis, revenue forecasting, market sizing, pricing, and more. Day to day, this person will evaluate and model new initiatives, work across senior stakeholders to drive alignment, and lead projects through to completion. This is a highly strategic role, sitting at the heart of how we drive growth for the company.

This role reports into the Growth Strategy & Operations team - we are a lean team, and success in the role depends on strong ownership, comfort operating independently, and effective collaboration across functions.

What Impact We're Looking for You to Make:

  • Build and sustain complex marketing models. Apply structural rigor and inform strategic decisions around how Jane tracks and evaluates marketing influence, spend, and other KPIs.

  • Own the full arc of an analysis, from insight to action. Across some of Jane’s most complex growth initiatives: structure the problem, build the analysis, craft the narrative, present to exec audiences, and follow up to make sure recommendations actually get implemented.

  • Drive Jane’s pricing and packaging strategy. Bring structure to how Jane thinks about pricing: grounding decisions in customer research and financial modeling, aligning stakeholders across the org, and shaping how new offerings get priced and packaged over time.

  • Track performance and diagnose when something goes wrong. Monitor how the business is doing against plan, and when a number moves unexpectedly, get to the real driver rather than the first explanation that sounds plausible.

  • Act as a thought partner and ‘go-to’ analytical resource for growth leaders; forecast, measure, and make optimization recommendations across channels: e.g., Paid Ads, Direct Mail, Trade Shows, etc.

  • Take on leadership’s most pressing priorities. Serve as a trusted thought partner on high-stakes, often ambiguous problems, working alongside Jane leadership to surface key insights and produce structured executive level perspectives.

  • Build strong working relationships across Jane. Partner effectively with teams across Marketing, Support, General Managers, and beyond, earning trust as someone who can get things done well with anyone in the building.

  • Raise the analytical bar for the team. Build repeatable frameworks and self-serve tools that make the team's recurring work faster and more rigorous over time.

What Experience We Need

  • Consulting or comparable background. 4+ years in top-tier management consulting (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) with a track record of driving operational improvements & owning strategic initiatives. Candidates from Tech BizOps, corporate strategy, or comparable analytical backgrounds will also be considered.

  • Strong quantitative skills. Proficiency with complex financial models, comfort working with large and imperfect datasets, and the ability to produce a defensible answer. SQL experience, or a willingness to learn it, is a plus.

  • Structured problem solving. A hypothesis-led, answer-first approach, with the ability to take an ambiguous, poorly-defined problem, break it down, and build a clear path to a solution.

  • Slide-building and storytelling. The ability to construct a clear narrative, build the deck to support it, and present it to executive stakeholders.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. Able to make progress without a fully-scoped brief and to prioritize effectively under time constraints.

  • A high bar for quality. Detail-oriented, producing work suitable for an exec level audience.

  • Independence and collaboration. Works autonomously while building trust and collaborating effectively across the organization.

  • Domain interest. Experience in or exposure to SaaS is a plus.

If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

More About Jane

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. You'll see that our salary ranges are quite large - this is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence. Most new hires join at the accomplished stage. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

  • 🇺🇸 For candidates based in the United States, the annual salary range is $156,000 - $253,500

  • 🇨🇦 For candidates based in Canada, the annual salary range is $148,000 - $240,500

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, You can learn more about it here!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.

jobs.title: Support Team Captain
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Hi, I’m Annie, Director of Support here at Jane. I’ve been at Jane for 11 years, and I lead our Support team. Our team exists to help the helpers - the practitioners and clinic owners running their practices every day. When they’re stuck, stressed, or unsure, we step in to remove obstacles so they can get back to caring for their patients. This work connects directly to Jane’s mission. The better we support our customers, the more time and energy they have to focus on the people who rely on them.

I live in North Vancouver and love running, especially when I need space to think through a challenge or reset after a full week.

This role is a special one. As a Team Captain, you’ll lead a team of around eight customer support reps and play a direct role in shaping their growth, confidence, and day-to-day experience at Jane. You’ll be close to the work - coaching in real time, navigating complex customer conversations, and using insights from quality reviews and metrics to help your team continuously improve.

Jane is in an exciting chapter of growth — including expanding further into the US market — and we're looking for a leader who's energized by what that brings. You'll play a meaningful role in shaping team culture, championing our customers, and helping the people around you do their best work. If you're passionate about developing others, solving real problems, and building an environment where both teammates and customers feel genuinely supported and celebrated, this is the kind of role where you'll thrive.

What Impact We're Looking for You to Make

  • Leading, growing and coaching your team. Lead a team of ~8 customer support reps, using Jane's 4C coaching model to deliver real-time feedback, structured development, and support through tough conversations.

  • Coach for demos and account setups. Support the team in delivering polished, confident demos and seamless account configurations.

  • Identify knowledge gaps and trends to build targeted coaching plans that grow confidence, skill, and team engagement — including helping your team build comfort and curiosity around emerging tools and AI-powered features.

  • Use support metrics (CSAT, First Call Resolution, and Quality) through weekly quality reviews to guide coaching, track progress, and address performance challenges proactively with thoughtful action plans.

  • Build an inclusive and trusting team culture — celebrating wins, creating space for open dialogue through regular 1:1s and team meetings, and keeping everyone informed on product updates, company direction, and support goals.

  • Lead through change with empathy, clarity, and a calm, solutions-focused approach, advocating for your team and your customers across departments.

Customer Excellence & Escalation Management

  • Handle customer escalations with empathy and urgency, offering real-time backup and coaching team members on how to navigate complex situations with confidence.

  • Spot trends in escalations and partner cross-functionally with CS Operations, and Content teams to improve workflows, reduce friction, and keep information accurate and current.

  • Stay up to date on Jane's features, workflows, and best practices — including AI-powered tools like Claude, Fellow — and help your team do the same, so every customer interaction is handled with expertise and care.

  • Bring genuine curiosity and a growth mindset to technology: comfortable exploring new tools like Claude and other AI assistants, asking questions, and helping your team feel confident in an evolving product landscape.

What Experience We Need

  • 5 years of leadership experience, leading in a high-touch customer service environment where employee engagement is key!

  • A strong coach and mentor - you know how to motivate, develop, and retain exceptional people, while holding space for honest feedback and accountability.

  • You bring ownership to everything you do, taking initiative and following through to drive real outcomes for your team and our customers.

  • With a customer-obsessed mindset, you’re passionate about delivering a best-in-class experience and helping others do the same.

  • You use data and insights to understand patterns, inform decisions, and guide improvements, without losing sight of the people behind the numbers.

  • You’re a confident communicator who fosters open, honest conversations across 1:1s, team meetings, and Slack, and you know how to influence and align others toward shared goals.

  • You’re curious, collaborative, and always looking for ways to improve how we work to create better experiences for customers, your team, and peers.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment help you navigate ambiguity and make thoughtful, timely decisions.

  • Adaptability and resilience, you stay steady through change and know how to support others in uncertain or fast-paced environments.

  • You’ve led remote or distributed teams and understand how to build connection and accountability across distance.

If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

More About Jane

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly. This role has an annual salary of $75,000 to $120,000. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full journey someone might take in the role.

For this role represents an annual salary of $90,000. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package. You can learn more about it here!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.

jobs.title: Enterprise Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Hi, I'm Alexa, Senior Cloud Security Engineer at Jane. I'm building our Platform Security function from the ground up, and this is one of the first roles that will shape it. You'll work closely with our Staff Enterprise Security Engineer on the day to day hardening work, and with me on where the function is headed next. I look for people who treat security as a partnership, not a gate, and who want real ownership, and the room to grow into it. This role offers both.

Join Jane as our new Enterprise Security Engineer, where you'll help harden the systems, endpoints, and identities that protect Jane and the sensitive health information our customers trust us with. You'll take on hands-on work across endpoint security, incident response, identity and access, and data protection. If you're energized by reducing real-world attack surface, comfortable owning well-scoped work end to end, and excited about using AI and automation to amplify your impact, we'd love to hear from you.

As a key executor on Jane's enterprise hardening roadmap, you'll work independently on well-scoped initiatives while partnering closely with IT, Infrastructure Engineering, and the rest of Security Engineering. Much of enterprise hardening depends on other teams, so you'll make security feel like partnership rather than an obstacle: bringing people along, delivering findings constructively, and knowing when a call is yours to make versus when to pull in a more senior engineer.

AI is core to how this team works, not a buzzword. We lean on AI and automation to cut toil, sharpen investigations, and move faster, and you'll be encouraged to experiment, build your own workflows, and share what works and what doesn't so the whole team levels up.

What Impact We're Looking For You To Make

  • Own Jane's endpoint hardening baseline, including CIS benchmark adoption, EDR coverage and tuning in CrowdStrike Falcon, and workstation and mobile vulnerability management, coordinating with IT to close findings within SLA.

  • Investigate, contain, and document security incidents and carry a share of the on-call rotation (roughly 5 to 6 weeks a year), escalating at the right time to the right people and keeping runbooks accurate based on real experience.

  • Strengthen identity and access by helping roll out phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2), Okta device trust and conditional access, and a BYOD program, partnering with IT to keep least-privilege posture healthy across systems.

  • Help stand up data-protection controls (SASE, CASB, DLP, egress filtering, and PHI handling) along with the guardrails that govern internal AI usage across tools, agents, MCP servers, and their access controls.

  • Tune detections and signal-to-noise in our SIEM (Datadog) and build AI-assisted automation that reduces toil, sharing wins and failures openly so the whole team gets better.

What Experience We Think We Need

  • 2 to 4 years in enterprise or infrastructure security, security operations, or incident response, with a track record of taking ownership and growing your skills.

  • Hands-on endpoint and EDR experience (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon) for triage, investigation, and hardening, plus incident response fundamentals and familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Practical identity and access knowledge across SSO and MFA, Okta or a similar IdP, conditional access, and least-privilege principles.

  • Working SIEM experience investigating alerts and separating signal from noise (Datadog a plus), and a habit of building AI or automation workflows that reduce toil, and sharing what you learn.

  • Strong written communication and genuine collaboration skills that build trust across IT and engineering and make people want to work with you. If you don't meet every qualification but are excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.

If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of $98,400 to $147,600. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hi, I'm Alexa https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexayiouroukis/, Senior Cloud Security Engineer at Jane. I'm building our Platform Security function from the ground up, and this is one of the first roles that will shape it. You'll work closely with our Staff Enterprise Security Engineer on the day to day hardening work, and with me on where the function is headed next. I look for people who treat security as a partnership, not a gate, and who want real ownership, and the room to grow into it. This role offers both.

Join Jane as our new Enterprise Security Engineer, where you'll help harden the systems, endpoints, and identities that protect Jane and the sensitive health information our customers trust us with. You'll take on hands-on work across endpoint security, incident response, identity and access, and data protection. If you're energized by reducing real-world attack surface, comfortable owning well-scoped work end to end, and excited about using AI and automation to amplify your impact, we'd love to hear from you.

As a key executor on Jane's enterprise hardening roadmap, you'll work independently on well-scoped initiatives while partnering closely with IT, Infrastructure Engineering, and the rest of Security Engineering. Much of enterprise hardening depends on other teams, so you'll make security feel like partnership rather than an obstacle: bringing people along, delivering findings constructively, and knowing when a call is yours to make versus when to pull in a more senior engineer.

AI is core to how this team works, not a buzzword. We lean on AI and automation to cut toil, sharpen investigations, and move faster, and you'll be encouraged to experiment, build your own workflows, and share what works and what doesn't so the whole team levels up.



WHAT IMPACT WE'RE LOOKING FOR YOU TO MAKE

 - Own Jane's endpoint hardening baseline, including CIS benchmark adoption, EDR coverage and tuning in CrowdStrike Falcon, and workstation and mobile vulnerability management, coordinating with IT to close findings within SLA.

 - Investigate, contain, and document security incidents and carry a share of the on-call rotation (roughly 5 to 6 weeks a year), escalating at the right time to the right people and keeping runbooks accurate based on real experience.

 - Strengthen identity and access by helping roll out phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2), Okta device trust and conditional access, and a BYOD program, partnering with IT to keep least-privilege posture healthy across systems.

 - Help stand up data-protection controls (SASE, CASB, DLP, egress filtering, and PHI handling) along with the guardrails that govern internal AI usage across tools, agents, MCP servers, and their access controls.

 - Tune detections and signal-to-noise in our SIEM (Datadog) and build AI-assisted automation that reduces toil, sharing wins and failures openly so the whole team gets better.


WHAT EXPERIENCE WE THINK WE NEED

 - 2 to 4 years in enterprise or infrastructure security, security operations, or incident response, with a track record of taking ownership and growing your skills.

 - Hands-on endpoint and EDR experience (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon) for triage, investigation, and hardening, plus incident response fundamentals and familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.

 - Practical identity and access knowledge across SSO and MFA, Okta or a similar IdP, conditional access, and least-privilege principles.

 - Working SIEM experience investigating alerts and separating signal from noise (Datadog a plus), and a habit of building AI or automation workflows that reduce toil, and sharing what you learn.

 - Strong written communication and genuine collaboration skills that build trust across IT and engineering and make people want to work with you. If you don't meet every qualification but are excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.

If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.



MORE ABOUT JANE

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers. This role is remote first. We are not hybrid.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of $98,400 to $147,600. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, which for this role represents an annual salary of $116,900. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this https://vimeo.com/880258361 short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, You can learn more about it here https://jane.app/documents/hiring/jane_benefits_overview.pdf!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app http://jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.
